author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Wiggins opts into player option with Heat
desc: Andrew Wiggins has opted in for his $30.1 million salary this 2026-27 season with the Heat.
impact: This move was expected by Wiggins. He will look to help out Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo as the new look Heat attempt to make a deep run next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trendon Watford has team option declined by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are not picking up the team option of Trendon Watford.
impact: Watford will become an unrestricted free agent. He will seek a depth role with another team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalen Terry has team option picked up by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are picking up the team option of Dalen Terry.
impact: Terry figures to remain in a depth role and off the fantasy radar for the 76ers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominick Barlow has team option exercised by 76ers
desc: The 76ers are picking up the team option of Dominick Barlow.
impact: Barlow figures to remain in a depth role and off the fantasy radar for the 76ers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trayce Jackson-Davis has team option exercised by Raptors
desc: Trayce Jackson-Davis had his $2.4 million team option exercised for next season by the Raptors.
impact: Jackson-Davis will remain in a reserve role for Toronto and off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Malachi Smith has team option exercised by Nets
desc: The Brooklyn Nets are exercising the team option on guard Malachi Smith.
impact: The deal is fully non-guaranteed for the 2026-27 season. Smith will remain in a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Deandre Ayton opting into player option with Lakers
desc: Deandre Ayton is opting into his $8.1 million player option with the Lakers.
impact: Ayton had a very up-and-down season in his first year with the Lakers. He'll figure to remain in a similar role heading into his second season with the team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luguentz Dort has team option exercised by Thunder
desc: The Thunder are exercising Luguentz Dort's $17.7 million team option for the 2026-27 season.
impact: The Thunder are continuing to explore trade options for Dort. It seems likely he will be on the move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Day'Ron Sharpe to sign new two-year deal with Nets
desc: Day'Ron Sharpe intends to sign a new two-year, $20 million deal to return to the Nets.
impact: The Nets declined Sharpe's team option to open the way for the new contract. He will remain in his primary depth role with Brooklyn.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Minott to sign new two-year deal with Nets
desc: Josh Minott intends to sign a new two-year, $9 million to return to the Nets.
impact: The Nets declined Minott's team option to lead to the new contract. He will remain in a reserve role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sandro Mamukelashvili declines player option with Raptors
desc: Sandro Mamukelashvili is declining his $2.8 million player option with the Raptors.
impact: Mamukelashvili will test the open market in free agency. He is expected to draw plenty of interest.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Draymond Green declining player option to become free agent
desc: Draymond Green is declining his player option to become a free agent. The move gives the Warriors the ability to persue LeBron James and Anthony Davis.
impact: A return to Golden State in free agency on a smaller deal is quite likely for Green, who could be trying to play the team game by allowing Golden State to make some all-in moves before returning. Still, in the event he finds himself elsewhere, that team will get themselves an agitator on defense who can still make an impact on offense.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Malik Beasley indicted on gambling charges
desc: Malik Beasley has been indicted on charges of gambling related to sports, including points shaving and prop bets.
impact: The free agent was already looking a bit on the outs to find a new home after some questionable play. This looks like it might cement it.

author: Garrett Ball
title: James Harden declines player option, will work out deal with Cavs
desc: James Harden will decline his player option for the 2026-27 season and will instead look to work out a multi-year deal with the Cavaliers.
impact: Harden joined the Cavs via trade from the Clippers and helped the team get to the Eastern Conference finals where they were swept by the eventual NBA champions. Harden may not be the player he once was, but he has morphed his role into being a good distributor of the ball and can take command in the regular season. It's the playoffs where he is largely suspect.

author: Garrett Ball
title: Fred VanVleet opting into $25 million player option
desc: Fred VanVleet is opting into his $25 million player option rather than becoming a free agent. He will stay in Houston and try to rebuild his value after coming off of a torn ACL.
impact: If VanVleet can get back to what he was pre-injury, which is getting harder to do as he ages, he should still be a vital part of the Rockets rotation as they search for a title. They looked a bit lost at times during the season, and VanVleet's experience could prove valuable to their chemistry and ability.
